review.posthog_relevance: Adds GitHub authentication support to the briefing prompt, potentially enabling authenticated GitHub CLI commands for PostHog-related workflows.
review.reason: Adds GitHub login parameter and conditional GitHub CLI command substitution in the briefing prompt template, allowing GitHub-specific CLI commands to use the authenticated GitHub account instead of a generic token or @me placeholder.
review.uncertainty: The change is localized to the briefing prompt configuration and does not demonstrate broader PostHog system behavior, adoption, or critical path reliability. The benefit is dependent on the unverified outcome of GitHub CLI command execution and authentication, which is not demonstrated in the provided code. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed.
